name: Muhd Lai Razi
description: Data analytics portfolio of Muhd Lai Razi — case studies built on Brunei's public datasets.
intro: I'm a Computer Science graduate (Monash University) working in AI/ML, with a focus on data analytics: cleaning messy data, finding the story in it, and presenting it clearly. Here I explore Brunei's publicly published datasets — the questions I asked, how I answered them, and what I found.
